name: SurvivalSpecialWaveEntry - Default (seed v1)
description: One entry of a survival scenario's special-wave schedule: a profile every n waves, or at one wave number (DESIGN S14, S53).

steps.description: Recurring: every Interval waves from Start wave on (5, 10, 15 … for interval 5). Explicit: one wave number; it beats every recurring entry for that wave. Recurring entries that can hit the same wave need different priorities (the lowest wins) or readiness fails.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Profile
fields.description: A special-wave profile of this scenario.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Recurring (every n waves) or Explicit (one wave number).

fields.label: Start wave
fields.description: Recurring: the first wave it applies to. Leave empty for the interval itself.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Recurring: the lowest value wins when two recurring entries hit the same wave (default 1).

fields.label: Wave number
fields.description: Explicit: the one wave this profile plays in.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Leave empty to add it after the existing entries.
